item: Switching protected mode on stops a running AI install (R765, row 232)
key_paths: src/llm/install_transport.py; src/safety/settings.py; src/llm/installer.py; src/llm/ollama.py; src/llm/pull_queue.py; src/llm/vllm_lifecycle.py; tests/test_ai_install_protected_switch.py
summary: The save that turns protected mode on writes the mode, then stops the running Ollama pull (and drops the queue), cancels the vLLM install and snapshot jobs (no step spawned after a stop), and ends the Ollama installer (its process group as root; a polled reader closes the pipe under sudo). A half-unpacked Ollama is not reported installed until an install finishes. The page and status endpoints say why it stopped.
